caption: find your rank. send it to the one who's #1. ranked by how many of december's big transits land in each sign.

slides.headline: the signs whose *december* changes the most, ranked
slides.dek: from #12 to #1. yours is in here

slides.headline: pisces, you get the quiet seat. enjoy it.
slides.body: the first quarter moon in your sign on dec 17 is your one nudge: act on the plan you made in november. otherwise the big transits happen elsewhere. a calm month is not a boring one. use it to notice who checks in on you.

slides.headline: aquarius, the slow burn continues.
slides.body: pluto keeps grinding through your sign, and jupiter, now retrograde in leo, sits opposite you. reads as partners pausing to rethink. let them. ask what they need instead of guessing.

slides.headline: gemini, the rewrite is still in progress.
slides.body: uranus stays retrograde in your sign until feb 8. astrologers read it as an inside job: changing your mind about what you want is allowed. tell people when it changes.

slides.headline: taurus, your ruler is across the room.
slides.body: venus, your ruling planet, sits in scorpio, your opposite sign, all month. reads as love focused on the other person: their needs, their timing. good month to ask, not to assume.

slides.headline: libra, you close the year on a clean-up.
slides.body: the last quarter moon lands in your sign on dec 30, and the moon is in libra for new year's eve. reads as letting go of one thing before midnight. release, don't ghost.

slides.headline: virgo, the engine is in your sign.
slides.body: mars is in virgo all month, and the sun trines it on dec 31, a good send-off. mars turns retrograde in your sign on jan 10, so finish the important ask before then.

slides.headline: scorpio, you are the most magnetic person at the party.
slides.body: venus is in your sign for the whole month and leaves on jan 7. reads as attention coming to you. the move is choosing who deserves it, and telling them.

slides.headline: sagittarius, your season ends on a high.
slides.body: the sun trines jupiter from your sign on dec 18, the friendliest aspect of the month, and mercury stays with you until dec 25. ask for the big thing before your season closes.

slides.headline: aries, things start moving again.
slides.body: saturn turned direct in your sign on dec 10 and neptune on dec 12. then the sun squares saturn on dec 29. reads as clarity, then a test of it. commit to fewer things, properly.

slides.headline: leo, the expansion takes a breath.
slides.body: jupiter turned retrograde in your sign on dec 12, then the sun trines it on dec 18. reads as a month to check that the big leap is the right leap. less audience, more truth.

slides.headline: cancer, the full moon is yours.
slides.body: the last full moon of 2026 is in your sign on dec 23, two nights before christmas. astrologers read it as feelings reaching the surface. say the soft thing out loud. it has to be mutual.

slides.headline: capricorn, the year ends in your hands.
slides.body: the sun enters your sign on dec 21, mercury follows on dec 25, and they meet in capricorn on jan 1. reads as the month you get to say what you want, plainly, and plan it. go first.

slides.headline: how we ranked: who gets the most *big transits*
slides.body: stations, the full moon and season changes count most. it is a reading, not a forecast.
